descriptionAboutMe: I am a Senior Software Engineer based in São Paulo with 10 years in technology. Since 2026, I have worked at Dock on the Pix team, covering MED, DICT, SPI, scheduled and automatic Pix, Matera integrations, billing, cash-in, and cash-out flows. I design and build APIs and microservices with TypeScript and Clean Architecture, using AWS, SQS, DLQs, Kubernetes, CloudFormation, Lambda, and Datadog. My experience also includes Bradesco, Mercado Livre, Itaú, Cognizant, and Tech Mahindra, working across Java, Spring Boot, Python, Node.js, React, cloud, SRE, observability, and test automation. I also work with LLMs, RAG, MCP, and AI APIs.
professionalObjective: I aim to work in Software Engineering, Software Architecture, or Artificial Intelligence solutions, contributing to APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and applications based on LLMs, RAG, and MCP.
educationSummary: Education: BSc in Computer Science (USJT, 2023), MBA in Software Architecture (FullCycle, 2025), and postgraduate studies in Full Stack Development (FIAP, 2026). Currently pursuing an MBA in Software Engineering (USP/Esalq) and postgraduate studies in AI Engineering (Impacta). Native Portuguese; intermediate English and Spanish.
resumeProjects: Selected projects: Hortelan, an IoT platform for garden monitoring; visual automation for web and mobile testing; and Donas do Som, a platform promoting women's inclusion in the music industry, built for the Sony Music Hackathon.
